installCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
buildCommand: flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=${API_BASE_URL:-https://fastapi-fortfolio.vercel.app} && flutter/bin/dart run tool/prepare_web_seo.dart
